main_text.p: 4. Non sese tamen extendit extra territorium.
5. Non etiam minor major effectus, ad omnem juris effectum censebitur esse major.
6. Quando majori sic facto currat tempus restitutionis in integram?
7. An qui major factus possit esse tutor?
8. De moribus quorundam mater vidua, qua minorennis potest esse tutrix.
9. Statutum de bonorum communione inter conjuges est reale.
10. Statutum de successionibus ab intestato reale est.
12. Ut filius-familias faciat testamentum, est statutum reale.
13. An in uno loco inhabilis alibi, ubi jus civile obtinet, testari possit cum effectu?
14. Forensis uti non poterit, alterius loci statuto.
15. Legitimatus in uno territorio non censetur esse legitimatus in alio, effectu inspecto.

page.notes: Printed text is in a fine italic with long s rendered as s; the first line's head word "144" is the page number. Long s was normalised to plain s per the rules; "sese" and similar are retained as printed. Line 6 "currat" and line 8 "qnæ" read as printed; "qna" was read as qua with a doubtful letter.
